title: Software Engineer III - Back-end Engineer - Chase UK
description:
**Job Description**
At JP Morgan Chase, we understand that customers seek exceptional value and a seamless experience from a trusted financial institution. That's why we launched Chase UK to transform digital banking with intuitive and enjoyable customer journeys. With a strong foundation of trust established by millions of customers in the US, we have been rapidly expanding our presence in the UK and soon across Europe. We have been building the bank of the future from the ground up, offering you the chance to join us and make a significant impact.
  
  
As a Software Engineer III - Back-End Engineer - Chase UK at JPMorgan Chase within the International Consumer Bank, you will play a crucial role in this initiative, dedicated to delivering an outstanding banking experience to our customers. You will work in a collaborative environment as part of a diverse, inclusive, and geographically distributed team. We are seeking individuals with a curious mindset and a keen interest in new technology. Our engineers are naturally solution-oriented and possess an interest in the financial sector and focus on addressing our customer needs. We work in teams focused on specific products and projects, providing opportunities to engage in areas such as fraud & financial crime prevention, identity services, money transfers, card payments, lending, customer onboarding, core banking, insurance products, rewards campaigns, and servicing innovations.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Contribute to end-to-end solutions in the form of cloud-native microservices architecture applications leveraging the latest technologies and the best industry practices
* Use domain modelling techniques to allow us to build best in class business products.
* Structure software so that it is easy to understand, test and evolve and build solutions that avoid single points of failure, using scalable architectural patterns.
* Develop secure code so that our customers and ourselves are protected from malicious actors.
* Promptly investigate and fix issues and ensure they do not resurface in the future and make sure our releases happen with zero downtime for our end-users.
* See that our data is written and read in a way that's optimized for our needs.
* Keep an eye on performance, making sure we use the right approach to identify and solve problems.
* Ensure our systems are reliable and easy to operate and keep us up to date by continuously updating our technologies and patterns.
* Support the products you've built through their entire lifecycle, including in production and during incident management
* Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and applied experience
* Recent hands-on professional experience as a back-end software engineer
* Experience in coding in a recent version of the Java programming language
* Experience in designing and implementing effective tests (unit, component, integration, end-to-end, performance, etc.)
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
* Understanding of cloud technologies, distributed systems, RESTful APIs and web technologies
* Familiarity with relational data stores
* Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* Experience in working in a highly regulated environment / industry
* Knowledge of messaging frameworks
* Familiarity with cloud-native microservices architecture
* Understanding of AWS cloud technologies

title: SDE II, EE Experiences, Progressive Discovery and Monetization
description:
**Description**
Everyday Essentials (EE) is a $100B+ business and one of the fastest-growing categories at Amazon — the household staples, health and personal care, grocery, and beauty products hundreds of millions of customers reorder. We're reinventing how customers discover, buy, and get more value from them, and we're looking for Software Development Engineers who want to build that future.
  
  
The EE Experiences organization builds the shopping experience for the products customers come back for most. Our charter is Progressive Discovery and Monetization (PDM): helping customers find better products for their needs, complete their baskets, and get more value on every essentials purchase — and giving the world's largest consumer brands new and effective ways to reach those customers and grow with Amazon. We build a durable, profitable business at the intersection of the two, on the surfaces customers use every day.
  
  
This is a space where the hardest problems don't have off-the-shelf answers. We're not polishing a solved product — we're inventing experiences that don't exist yet, and the decisions we make now shape a business with room to grow for years. You'll have the freedom to propose new ideas, prototype them, and ship them worldwide. Your work moves from whiteboard to production in front of a very large customer base, with visibility all the way to senior leadership.
  
  
We're an AI-first team, and that shows up in two ways. We use AI throughout how we build software, and we expect our engineers to keep learning and applying the latest tools to move faster and raise the quality bar. AI is also at the core of what we build — the intelligence that helps customers find the right product is a modeling and engineering problem we work on hand in hand with scientists. If you're curious about AI, learn quickly, and like using it to solve real customer problems while keeping a clear head about where it helps and where it doesn't, you'll fit right in.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, build, and own software end to end - working backwards from the customer through design, code, testing, deployment, and operations.
* Take on ambiguous problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, bring clarity, and deliver simple solutions to hard problems.
* Partner closely with scientists, product managers, and designers to turn customer problems into products that ship worldwide.
* Use AI tools and modern engineering practices to build faster and at a higher bar of quality, and help the team level up how it uses them.
* Own operational excellence for what you build - monitor it, respond when issues arise, and keep improving the customer and partner experience.
* Raise the technical bar through code reviews, mentoring, and hiring for the best talent.

A day in the life
  
  
Most days start with the customer problem in front of you: how to help someone find a better everyday-essentials product, or fill their basket faster. You dig into data, sketch a design, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before writing any code. By the afternoon you might be prototyping an idea that didn't exist yesterday, reviewing a teammate's change, or debugging something in production. Because so much here is new, you won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your work reach customers in weeks, not quarters.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our team owns how customers discover and buy the everyday essentials they rely on — and how the brands behind those products reach them. Our mission is to make restocking the things you need effortless, and to help customers find better options along the way. Day to day you'll work with fellow engineers and partner closely with product managers, designers, and scientists, who bring the customer and data insight that shapes what we build. We're a small, fast-moving group solving open-ended problems for hundreds of millions of shoppers — a place where you own problems end to end and your ideas reach customers fast.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
* Experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems

title: Software Development Engineer II, Unified Auth SDK
description:
**Description**
UnifiedAuth is the authentication and authorization backbone for Amazon's service ecosystem. We secure service-to-service communication, ensuring that every call between Amazon services is authenticated and authorized against the right identity and policy. As Amazon's systems evolve toward autonomous agents, we provide agentic authentication and authorization — establishing verifiable identity and scoped, policy-governed access for AI agents acting on behalf of users and services. We also own transaction token management, issuing, propagating, and validating the tokens that carry identity and authorization context across multi-hop request chains. Together, these capabilities let Amazon's services trust who is calling them, what those callers are permitted to do, and on whose behalf they act — protecting customer data and maintaining the integrity of every transaction across the fleet.
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II to design, build, and operate components of our authentication SDKs and supporting services. You will own features end-to-end: design through production operations across Java, Python, NodeJS, and Rust client libraries. You will collaborate with security teams, service owners, and business teams to close authentication gaps at scale.
  
  
This role suits an engineer who wants to own ambiguous, high-impact problems in a domain where correctness and availability are non-negotiable.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and deliver features across Security SDKs, owning them from design document through production launch.
* Improve the static stability of authentication — ensure services continue operating through service outages via persistent caching, eager token refresh, and bounce-safe recovery.
* Build and maintain telemetry and compliance mechanisms that measure token propagation and detect gaps across the fleet.
* Diagnose and resolve production issues as part of the on-call rotation, and drive root-cause analysis and corrections for operational events.
* Own pipeline and release health for SDK components — keep pipelines fresh, unblock releases, and reduce time-to-deploy.
* Write clear design documents and participate in Operational Readiness Reviews (ORRs) and security reviews.
* Mentor SDE1s and interns; raise the technical bar through code reviews and design feedback.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Java Software Engineer - Connectors - Remote
description:
Jitterbit automates and orchestrates business systems to empower teams, unlock value, and accelerate business transformation. With Jitterbit, organizations can streamline operations, enhance data accessibility, and deliver on a growing list of IT needs more quickly and confidently.

For organizations ready to modernize and innovate, Jitterbit provides a unified AI-infused low-code platform for integration, orchestration, automation, and app development that accelerates business transformation, boosts productivity, and unlocks value. The Jitterbit Harmony platform, including iPaaS, API Manager, App Builder and EDI, future-proofs operations, simplifies complexity and drives innovation for organizations globally.

**Job Description**

Jitterbit is seeking a Java Backend Software Engineer to join our Engineer team. Jitterbit is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) and API Management platform that has been recognized in the leader quadrant of Gartner for five straight years. Our customers use our iPaaS and API Manager platform to solve mission-critical business problems. What is our challenge? To make it easy to integrate our customers’ systems. In order to do this, we need to build and create a SaaS offering that is reliable, stable, and scalable for our customers. Do you have the design, architecting, and code-writing capabilities to take on this challenge? And can succeed in a big way?

About the Team

The engineering team at Jitterbit believes that the quality of our code reflects directly on us as professionals. We are relentless about crafting a product that is innovative and delivers a memorable user experience; an experience that is fast and robust. As a key engineer on our team, you will collaborate with other engineers, product management, and operations.

Our culture is fun, fast-paced, performance-oriented, open, and collegial. We are constantly pushing the technology envelope to the edge! We are very distributed and our culture is set up to make all of us very effective working remotely. We believe in hiring talent where it exists.

Key team values:

* Quality-first mindset: We believe code quality directly reflects on us as professionals
* Distributed ownership: Engineers own their subsystems end-to-end, from design to production support
* Mentorship culture: Senior engineers actively develop junior talent and foster technical growth
* Innovation mindset: We constantly explore new technologies and architectural patterns to stay ahead

About the Job

As a Java Backend Software Engineer, you will join our team to design, architect, and implement robust, scalable distributed systems that power our SaaS platform. This role offers significant technical depth and opportunities for engineers ready to grow into more senior responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities:

* Design and implement high-performance, fault-tolerant connector integrations and adapters that reliably handle mission-critical business workflows 24x7x365.
* Architect distributed microservices following cloud-native design patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, observability, etc.) for multi-tenant SaaS environments.
* Build and optimize data pipelines handling multiple protocols (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks) and communication patterns (synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven).
* Drive technical decisions on critical subsystems; contribute to RFCs and architectural reviews; mentor junior engineers on system design principles.
* Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing; own the operational health and observability of deployed systems.
* Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and SRE teams to deliver features, resolve production incidents, and improve platform reliability.
* Champion best practices: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, chaos), security hardening, and performance optimization.
* Contribute to platform infrastructure and developer experience initiatives that benefit the entire engineering organization.

About You

You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built.

You will be successful in this role if you:

* Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer.
* Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture.
* Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives.
* Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers.
* Are able to make data-driven decisions.
* Are a believer in the best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from.
* Are an accountability engineer in the team and passionate about making people succeed through the code you push.

**Qualifications**

We are looking for:

* 7+ years designing and building large-scale, distributed backend systems handling high throughput and low latency requirements.
* 5+ years working with multi-tenant SaaS architectures in production; deep understanding of isolation, rate-limiting, and resource management across tenants.
* Proven ability to drive system design and participate in architectural decisions; experience mentoring engineers on design patterns and best practices.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills; demonstrated ability to diagnose complex, production issues in distributed systems.
* Deep experience with microservices architecture, including service decomposition, API design, and inter-service communication patterns.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure); familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and serverless patterns.
* Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals: SOLID principles, design patterns, system design, testing strategies (unit, integration, e2e).

Technical Skills and Experience:

* Expert-level Java (Java 8+): Strong OOP principles, concurrency, performance tuning, memory management (heap, GC), and the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot, Guava, Netty, etc.).
* Protocol expertise: REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, and related concepts (HTTP semantics, caching, rate limiting, error handling).
* Message brokers & event streaming: Hands-on experience with RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS, or similar; understanding of at-least-once delivery, dead-letter queues, and stream processing.
* Database technologies: Strong SQL (query optimization, indexing); experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra) and their consistency trade-offs.
* Containerization & orchestration: Proficiency with Docker; practical experience with Kubernetes or container runtimes in production.
* Version control: Advanced Git workflows (branching strategies, rebasing, cherry-picking); experience with GitHub or similar platforms.
* CI/CD & DevOps: Working knowledge of GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, or similar; ability to write build pipelines, deployment scripts, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
* OS & systems: Comfortable with Linux command line; understanding of OS-level concepts (memory allocation, processes, file systems, networking).
* Observability: Experience with logging (ELK, Splunk), metrics (Prometheus, Grafana), and distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin).

**Additional Information**

**What You’ll Get:**

* Work for a growing leader within the Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tech space
* Join a mission-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business-critical processes.
* Career development and mentorship
* A flexible, remote-friendly company with personality and heart

**Please be advised that Jitterbit does not:**

* Conduct interviews through unsecure messaging platforms.
* Request sensitive personal information, such as social security numbers or bank details, during initial contact.
* Require payment or fees from applicants at any stage of the hiring process.
* Offer unrealistic salaries or benefits packages.

Jitterbit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

description:
**Job Description**
Honeywell is looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to help build and evolve enterprise-scale platform services supporting Honeywell Forge and the Cognition platform.
  
  
This role is suited for a strong hands-on software engineer with 5+ years of experience developing modern applications, APIs, backend services, and distributed systems. The engineer will contribute across user experiences, APIs, microservices, data and messaging infrastructure and containerized deployments.
  
  
You will work closely with technical leads, architects, SRE, cybersecurity, QA, product, and other engineering teams to translate product and architecture requirements into secure, scalable, maintainable, and production-ready software. The ideal candidate is comfortable owning features and services from design and implementation through automated testing, deployment, integration, troubleshooting, and production readiness.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and develop containerized microservices and distributed platform components.
* Implement well-defined service interfaces, APIs, contracts, and reusable abstractions.
* Develop event-driven services using RabbitMQ or similar messaging technologies and asynchronous processing patterns.
* Build services interacting with relational databases, time-series data stores, caching technologies, and file/object storage.
* Implement reliable service-to-service communication, error handling, retry, and integration patterns.
* Troubleshoot issues across distributed services and their dependencies.
* Develop software that can support deployment across Azure, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, and Cognition environments.
* Contribute to a common platform codebase while maintaining appropriate separation between common functionality and provider-specific implementations.
* Apply abstraction and adapter patterns where needed to minimize unnecessary cloud-provider dependencies.
* Develop software capable of operating in Cognition edge/appliance environments, including deployments with limited or restricted connectivity.
* Build platform components with appropriate consideration for CPU, memory, storage, and network utilization.
* Develop and support services deployed in Kubernetes-based environments.
* Contribute to installation, configuration, upgrade, and lifecycle-management capabilities for platform services.
* Follow engineering and security requirements associated with regulated, restricted-connectivity, or air-gapped deployments.

**Engineering & Collaboration Expectations**

* Take ownership of assigned features, services, and technical problems with limited supervision.
* Translate technical designs and requirements into high-quality working software.
* Participate constructively in architecture and design discussions.
* Provide thoughtful code reviews and help maintain engineering standards.
* Collaborate effectively with technical leads, architects, Product Owners, SRE, cybersecurity, QA, and application teams.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, maintainability concerns, and integration issues early.
* Diagnose technical issues spanning applications, services, messaging, databases, Kubernetes, and infrastructure.
* Contribute to technical investigations and proof-of-concepts for new technologies or platform capabilities.

**Qualifications**
**Core Technical Qualifications**
The ideal candidate should have solid hands-on experience with most of the following:
  
  

* Modern full-stack application development
* Web application architecture and modern frontend engineering
* RESTful APIs and backend service development
* .NET and C# development
* Microservices and distributed-system concepts

* Event-driven architecture and asynchronous processing


+ RabbitMQ or comparable enterprise messaging technology



+ SQL and relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL or comparable platforms



+ Caching technologies such as Redis



+ Data-processing and persistence concepts



+ Authentication, authorization, and secure API design



+ Automated unit, API, component, and integration testing



+ Observability, structured logging, and production troubleshooting



+ Git-based development, branching, pull-request, and release workflows

* Strong hands-on experience with .NET/C# is particularly relevant to the existing platform-services landscape.

**Experience Profile**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of professional software-development experience, with substantial hands-on development responsibility.
* Strong experience building production-quality backend, full-stack, or platform software.
* Experience developing services using microservice, API-driven, and distributed-system architectures.
* Practical experience with containerized applications, automated testing, and CI/CD.
* Ability to independently design and deliver moderately complex software components and features.
* Experience troubleshooting applications and distributed services in development, integration, or production environments.

**Preferred / Differentiating Experience**
Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable:
  
  

* Industrial IoT or connected-device platforms
* Edge computing or appliance-based software
* Hybrid-cloud or multi-cloud platforms
* Air-gapped or restricted-connectivity environments
* Large-scale telemetry or event-processing systems
* Kubernetes-based edge deployments
* Time-series databases
* Device and gateway management
* Secure software-development lifecycle practices

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

* Framework: The ability to understand, utilize, design, and develop complex structures and systems in various contexts such as programming, project management, or business strategy. This ability requires critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Infrastructure
description:
**The Role**
Sarvam's products produce events, model traces, evals and billing data, and need to read that data back. The Data Platform team builds and runs the central data infrastructure every product uses: ingestion, streaming, the analytical warehouse, transformations, access control and audit.
  
  
We are hiring a Software Engineer / Senior Software Engineer (2–5 years of experience) to own this platform end to end. You will design, build and run systems that other teams depend on in production, and make real decisions on database internals, streaming and platform design. Stack: Go/Python, ClickHouse Cloud, Kafka, Avro, Airflow, dbt, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS.
  
  
**What You'll Own & Do**

* Build and run the ingestion path: the service every product sends events to, Kafka behind it, and the pipes that land data in ClickHouse within seconds. Own schema validation, rate limits, dead-letter handling and the client SDKs.
* Own the warehouse: ClickHouse Cloud. Design tables for the read path (sorting keys, partitions, materialized views, TTL), separate compute per workload, set per-user limits and per-tenant isolation, and attribute cost to the team that spent it.
* Build reliable data pipelines and solve data problems: dbt models and Airflow DAGs with the BI engineers, CDC from product databases, sync and backfill jobs that are safe to re-run, and the data problems product teams bring you, such as a late source, a number that doesn't match or a query that has slowed down.
* Make the platform self-serve: a registry of every dataset with its owner, schema, freshness and access; provisioning and permissions as code.
* Run it in production: everything as Terraform and Helm with metrics, traces and alerts; be on call; handle incidents end to end, write the RCA and fix the root cause.
* Grow the platform: new products keep arriving. You will help decide what the platform should do next and build it, whether that is a new source or sink, or a new way for teams to use the data.

**What We're Looking For**

* 2–5 years of experience building, shipping and running large-scale, data-intensive systems in production, ideally at a startup where you owned things and were on call for them.
* Deep expertise in at least one of: an OLAP database (ClickHouse preferred; Druid, BigQuery or Redshift also fine) or Kafka / event streaming. You understand how a columnar store writes, merges and scans data, or how a partitioned log gives ordering and delivery guarantees.
* Experience with large-scale messaging systems like Kafka or RabbitMQ: partitions, consumer groups, delivery guarantees, backpressure.
* Good at Go, or good at Python.
* You know the usual data-system problems: schema evolution, idempotency, backpressure, partitioning, retention and TTL, CDC.
* You have built or run at least one of: an event pipeline, a transformation layer (dbt, Spark or SQL on Airflow), a provisioning or control-plane service, or a multi-tenant data service with access control.
* Comfortable with AWS, Kubernetes and Terraform in production.
* You test before shipping, debug with metrics and traces, write RCAs, and document what you build.
* Passion for data infrastructure and for enabling others by making their data easier to access.

**Nice to Have**

* ClickHouse in production: MergeTree, materialized views, projections, quotas, settings profiles, row policies, ClickHouse Cloud.
* Kafka in depth: MSK, Kafka Connect, schema registry (Glue or Confluent), Avro.
* dbt and Airflow at scale.
* Audit or security data systems: append-only logs, integrity checks, tenant isolation.
* OpenTelemetry, LLM observability (Langfuse or similar), eval pipelines.
* Built an internal platform that other teams adopted.

description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an
**AI Engineer**
to work on an enterprise AI platform that is transforming how public-sector organizations evaluate tenders and procurement documents.

Our platform uses
**Generative AI, Agentic AI, document intelligence and open-source foundation models**
to automate complex document-heavy workflows involved in tender evaluation. The product is already deployed in large
**Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs)**
and runs on
**NVIDIA GPU infrastructure**
using open-source AI models.

This role sits at the intersection of
**AI research and production engineering**
. You will experiment with new models and techniques, but the goal is not research for its own sake — it is to
**improve accuracy, reduce latency and cost, and make the product increasingly autonomous.**

**What You Will Work On**

* Experiment with and evaluate the latest
  **open-source LLMs and VLMs**
  for document understanding, extraction, reasoning and classification.
* Benchmark models for
  **accuracy, latency, throughput and GPU utilization**
  and make recommendations for production adoption.
* Optimize AI inference pipelines to improve
  **response time, throughput and infrastructure efficiency**
  .
* Develop and deploy
  **Agentic AI workflows**
  that can autonomously execute multi-step document processing and tender evaluation tasks.
* Design agents capable of planning, reasoning, tool use, information retrieval and validation across complex procurement workflows.
* Build production-grade pipelines for processing
  **large, complex and highly unstructured documents**
  .
* Work on techniques such as
  **RAG, structured extraction, reranking, model routing, prompt engineering and evaluation**
  .
* Fine-tune or adapt models where appropriate to improve performance on domain-specific procurement tasks.
* Work closely with product and domain teams to translate business requirements into AI capabilities.
* Profile and optimize GPU workloads across
  **NVIDIA GPU infrastructure**
  .
* Develop robust evaluation frameworks to continuously measure
  **LLM accuracy, hallucination, latency and reliability**
  .
* Stay current with developments in open-source models, inference frameworks and agentic AI, and rapidly prototype promising approaches.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Must Have**

* **3–5 years of hands-on experience**
  building and deploying AI/ML systems.
* Strong
  **Python programming**
  and software engineering fundamentals.
* Strong understanding of
  **Generative AI / LLMs**
  and modern AI application architectures.
* Hands-on experience deploying models in production environments.
* Experience with
  **open-source LLMs**
  such as Llama, Qwen, Mistral, DeepSeek or similar models.
* Experience with
  **GPU-based inference and optimization**
  .
* Strong understanding of model performance metrics including
  **latency, throughput, concurrency and GPU utilization**
  .
* Experience with
  **Docker and Linux**
  ; Kubernetes is a strong plus.
* Ability to read research papers, understand new techniques and turn them into working production systems.
* Strong problem-solving mindset and willingness to experiment rapidly.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with
  **NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA, TensorRT, Triton Inference Server, vLLM or NVIDIA NIM**
  .
* Experience with
  **Agentic AI / AI agents**
  , tool calling, orchestration and multi-agent workflows.
* Experience with
  **RAG, vector databases, embeddings and reranking**
  .
* Experience with
  **LLM/VLM evaluation and benchmarking**
  .
* Experience with document AI, OCR, document understanding or multimodal models.
* Experience with
  **PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers and PEFT/LoRA**
  .
* Familiarity with cloud or on-prem GPU deployments.
* Experience working with large-scale enterprise AI deployments.

**What Success Looks Like**

In this role, you will be expected to move beyond simply integrating LLM APIs. You will help us answer questions such as:

* **Can we make the model 20% more accurate?**
* **Can we reduce inference latency by 30%?**
* **Can we run the workload on fewer GPUs?**
* **Can an AI agent autonomously complete a document evaluation workflow that currently requires human intervention?**
* **Can we reliably deploy a new open-source model into production without compromising quality?**

You will have significant ownership in taking these ideas from
**experiment → benchmark → engineering → production**
.

**Why Join Us?**

You will work on an AI product that is already solving
**real enterprise problems in production**
, rather than building prototypes that never leave the lab.

The role offers an opportunity to work across:

**Open-source AI models → AI research → GPU optimization → Agentic AI → Production engineering → Enterprise deployment**

If you enjoy going deep into models, experimenting with new AI techniques, writing production-grade code and seeing your work directly improve a live AI product, this role is for you.

title: ServiceNow -Dev -Senior
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Senior**
As part of our EY GDS-ServiceNow team, you will work to solve client problems using ServiceNow platform. You will get an opportunity to work with high quality team. You will get an opportunity to build innovating product which solves client’s problem.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Senior with expertise in ServiceNow Implementation to join the EYD GDS ServiceNow. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Performs Configuration/Customization of the ServiceNow system, including creation workflows
* Builds service request fulfilment workflow from customer requirements including requests, request items and tasks using workflows, UI actions, client scripts, business rules, etc
* Uses scripting tools and Service Now functionality to automate rote tasks
* Performs integrations and process automation using Orchestration, Web Services, Soap calls, etc.
* Gathers specifications from the business departments and delivers a product/release that meets the needs presented. Interprets business and functional requirements and develops technical specifications documentation
* Load, manipulate and maintain data between Service-now and other systems as needed
* Work with business liaison to generate dashboards, home pages, performance analytics data collectors and reports as needed
* Must analyse and fully understand user stories and internal procedures in order to improve system capabilities, automate process workflows and address scheduling limitations throughout the development and delivery of the ServiceNow releases
* Performs system and integration testing with sample and live data

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Authentication protocols such as Active Directory / LDAP or SiteMinder federation /Azure
* Disciplined Agile Delivery software release build/deploy processes
* Integrating with internal and external applications and systems
* JavaScript, HTML, Angular JS and good web design practices
* Service Portal implementation experience
* Implementation experience on any of the following applications like Agentic AI, Gen AI, ITOM/HRSD/CSM/SPM/SecOps/IRM/ITSM, Flow designer, HAM, SAM, Integration, ITAM, Service Now Portal/UI Builder, SPM.
* Implementation experience on Performance Analytics.
* Knowledge of digital technologies like Machine learning, AI, IOT, Blockchain

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences
* Approximately 4 to 6 years of experience in a development role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period
* ServiceNow CSA certification plus any CIS is mandatory
* ITIL foundations certification a plus

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience on SDLC or TFS or JIRA or equivalent tool to maintain stories.
* Knowledge about ServiceNow’s latest version’s features.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 250+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY ServiceNow practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Applied AI Solutions Engineer – PHB Commercial Transformation
description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
At Novonesis, we believe biology holds the key to solving some of the world's biggest challenges. To unlock that potential, we are scaling AI capabilities that help our sales, marketing, and technical service teams work smarter, serve customers better, and create measurable business impact.
  
  
As an
**Applied AI Solutions Engineer**
, you will join the Strategy Deployment team within the Planetary Health Biosolutions (PHB) business division. Working at the intersection of applied AI, commercial problem-solving, and business transformation, you will help turn high-value opportunities into practical AI solutions that transform how commercial teams operate.
  
  
This is a forward-deployed engineering opportunity for someone who wants to combine strong technical expertise with visible business impact. You will move between commercial workflows, solution design, and hands-on development, owning the journey from identifying a business challenge to delivering solutions that users genuinely adopt and value.
  
  
**The Role & Your Impact**
In this role, you will design, build, deploy, and continuously improve AI solutions that enable PHB commercial teams to work more effectively and create measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI Solution Development**

* Work directly with PHB commercial teams to understand workflows, user needs, and business challenges, translating them into practical AI solutions.
* Design and build AI agents, applications, and workflows utilizing prompting, grounding, retrieval, tool usage, actions, and orchestration.
* Develop thin-slice solutions to rapidly validate user value and technical feasibility.
* Build iteratively with users, leveraging feedback and evidence to improve, redesign, or discontinue solutions where appropriate.

**Integration & Engineering**

* Securely connect AI solutions to enterprise platforms and data sources, including Salesforce, Microsoft 365, and approved AI services.
* Build integrations using APIs, connectors, and workflow technologies with appropriate identity, security, and approval controls.
* Work with structured and unstructured data, enterprise knowledge sources, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns.
* Design and develop solutions with security, privacy, responsible AI, maintainability, and reuse in mind.

**Evaluation, Deployment & Scale**

* Design and execute functional, integration, regression, and AI-specific evaluations covering groundedness, retrieval quality, agent behavior, reliability, and user experience.
* Test solutions with end users and make data-driven decisions on whether to scale, iterate, or stop initiatives.
* Deploy, monitor, support, and continuously improve production solutions in partnership with Central IT, ComEx, and other enterprise stakeholders.
* Document solutions, technical patterns, and key learnings to support ongoing maintenance, reuse, and scale across the organization.

**Required Qualifications**
**What You'll Need to Be Successful**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2–6 years of relevant professional experience building and deploying AI, GenAI, or agent-based solutions in production environments.
* Hands-on experience with LLMs, AI agents, prompting, grounding, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool use, and orchestration frameworks.
* Strong programming skills in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Experience working with APIs, data integration, Git/version control, testing practices, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience building workflows and integrations using technologies such as Microsoft Power Platform, Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, Salesforce Flow, REST APIs, or similar tools.
* Experience taking AI solutions from prototype through deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
* Good understanding of cloud platforms, identity and access management, secure enterprise data handling, responsible AI, and production reliability.
* Ability to work directly with business users and technical teams to translate business challenges into practical technology solutions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Salesforce Agentforce, UiPath, or comparable technologies.
* Experience supporting sales, marketing, customer engagement, or commercial business functions.
* Curiosity and adaptability to work across different AI models, platforms, and frameworks while selecting the best technology for the business problem.
* Experience working in fast-paced environments with evolving priorities and emerging technologies.

What We Offer
  
  
At Novonesis, you will help shape how AI transforms commercial operations across a global, purpose-driven organization. You will work alongside experienced colleagues, gain exposure to cutting-edge AI technologies, and contribute to solutions that create tangible value for customers and the business.
  
  
We offer an environment that encourages innovation, learning, ownership, and professional growth while supporting our purpose of unlocking the power of biology to address global challenges.
  
  
**Application Deadline:**
November 23rd November 2026 - We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.
  
  
We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.
  
  
**Explore Other Openings**
If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

description:
**Description and Requirements**
**"At BMC trust is not just a word - it's a way of life!"**
**Description And Requirements**
CareerArc Code
  
  
CA-BS
  
  
**Hybrid**
BMC empowers nearly 80% of the Forbes Global 100 to accelerate business value, faster than humanly possible. Our industry-leading portfolio unlocks human and machine potential to drive business growth, innovation, and sustainable success. BMC does this in a simple and optimized way by connecting people, systems, and data that power the world’s largest organizations so they can seize a competitive advantage.
  
  
At BMC, we don’t do ordinary. Across BMC, our AI teams are building the next generation of agentic AI, capabilities that help enterprises run their most critical systems faster, more resiliently, and with confidence. Our agentic AI empowers autonomous agents to detect, diagnose, and help resolve complex problems with speed, accountability, and human oversight.
  
  
We’re not hiring for roles; we’re hiring for impact. You’ll solve hard problems, build smart solutions, and work with people who challenge and champion you, and see your work make a difference for customers running mission-critical systems.
  
  
You will build autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents that plan, reason, make decisions, and execute tasks, and orchestrate multi-agent systems that integrate with tools, APIs, and enterprise applications. Everything you build must meet enterprise standards: secure, reliable, scalable, observable, and governed.
  
  
**Here is how, through this role, you will contribute to BMC’s and your own success:**

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade agentic AI applications using modern LLMs and AI frameworks.
* Build autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents capable of planning, reasoning, decision-making, and task execution.
* Develop multi-agent systems and orchestrate interactions between agents, tools, APIs, and enterprise applications.
* Integrate AI agents with internal and external services through APIs, databases, messaging systems, and workflow engines.
* Build and deploy RAG solutions using vector databases and enterprise knowledge sources.
* Optimize AI workflows for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Implement observability, monitoring, guardrails, and governance mechanisms for production AI systems.
* Build and run agent evaluations — define eval sets, test behaviour, iterate on prompts, tools, and workflows.
* Package and deploy solutions in production; apply strong diagnostics across the AI stack.
* Collaborate with product, architects, and stakeholders; contribute to reviews, documentation, and best practices.
* Define shared agentic patterns, evaluation practices, and production standards across teams.
* Lead architecture for cross-cutting AI capabilities used by multiple products/squads.
* Coach AI engineers; raise the bar for quality, safety, and cost discipline.
* Partner with AI Quality, SRE, and Security on release gates and ops practices.

**To ensure you’re set up for success, you will bring the following skillset & experience:**

* 8–13 years of relevant experience
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, AI, ML, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Hands-on experience with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Llama, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or similar) and agentic SDKs as level requires.
* Understanding of prompt engineering, tool/function calling, planning, reasoning, and workflow orchestration.
* Python; REST APIs, microservices, cloud, containers, CI/CD, and testing — depth scales with level.
* Evals for LLM/RAG/Agent use cases; observability (Langfuse, OpenSearch, OpenTelemetry) as level requires.
* Strong communication and ownership mindset.
* Multi-team adoption of patterns or practices you led.
* Sets technical direction for an AI area, not only delivers features.
* Balances innovation speed with enterprise quality, safety, and cost.

**Whilst these are nice to have, our team can help you develop in the following skills:**

* Frontier/foundation models beyond API usage (evaluation, adaptation, fine-tuning).
* Open-weight models and local inference (vLLM, Ollama, Hugging Face).
* Data exploration techniques and tools.
* Agile / Atlassian; advanced IDEs (Cursor, IntelliJ, VSCode).

BMC’s culture is built around its people. We have 6000+ brilliant minds working together across the globe. You won’t be known just by your employee number, but for your true authentic self. BMC lets you be YOU!

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. #VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking a Cloud ML Engineer (AWS) within Data & Analytics GSL to use ML/AI expertise alongside strong programming and software engineering skills to make machine learning models and analyses easier to use and access. The role supports local markets and group functions to obtain business value from machine learning, and focuses on designing ML systems, productionising prototypes, enabling robust data flows, and evolving Big Data capabilities through reusable assets and patterns.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design and develop machine learning systems and implementation patterns
* Automate predictive model software, including model training
* Productionise data science prototypes and develop machine learning applications aligned to data science requirements
* Facilitate the flow of data between ML/AI models and the organisation’s data systems
* Enhance data pipelines to ensure data is clean, accurate, and optimised for machine learning models
* Partner with the architecture team to evolve Big Data platform capabilities (reusable assets/patterns) and components to meet business requirements and objectives
* Research, investigate, and evaluate new technologies and methods to improve delivery and sustainability of machine learning applications and services
* Contribute to defining best practice for agile development of applications running on the Big Data platform

**Who You Are**

* Experience managing the development lifecycle for agile software development projects (Kanban or Scrum exposure)
* Robust data modelling and data architecture skills
* Knowledge of Big Data frameworks such as Hadoop, Spark, Hive, Yarn, and Airflow
* Experience with distributed ML frameworks (for example H2O and/or TensorFlow) and various ML libraries
* Proven experience creating and deploying end-to-end ML pipelines in production, including MLOps
* Programming experience in Java and Python
* Experience with containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes) or cloud alternatives is advantageous
* Mandatory working experience with AWS services including: SageMaker Pipelines, SageMaker Studio, CloudFormation, CloudTrail, SNS, EventBridge, CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeCommit
* Experience with other distributed technologies, NoSQL databases, and streaming technologies is desirable
* Strong written and verbal communication, with excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills
* Must have technical / professional qualifications:

+ 3-year IT or IS degree or diploma (or related field) is essential; an advanced degree in Computer Science/Math/Statistics (or related discipline) is an advantage
+ Relevant cloud certification at professional or associate level
+ 5+ years of relevant experience as an AI/ML Engineer
+ 5+ years of BI or related software development experience

If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

* Opportunities to deliver business value by enabling scalable ML capabilities for local markets and group functions
* The chance to work on production-grade ML systems, end-to-end pipelines, and MLOps practices on AWS
* Collaboration with architecture teams to shape reusable Big Data platform assets and engineering patterns
* Scope to explore and evaluate new technologies and methods to improve sustainability and delivery of ML applications and services

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Strengthening best practices for productionising data science prototypes into reliable ML applications
* Deepening hands-on expertise in AWS-native MLOps and pipeline automation (including SageMaker and AWS developer tools)
* Enhancing Big Data platform design skills through reusable patterns, components, and data pipeline optimisation
* Improving cost and resource efficiency approaches across compute, network usage, and platform objectives

description:

At Novonesis, we believe biology holds the key to solving some of the world's biggest challenges. To unlock that potential, we are scaling AI capabilities that help our sales, marketing, and technical service teams work smarter, serve customers better, and create measurable business impact.
  
  
As a
**Senior Applied AI Solutions Engineer**
, you will join the Strategy Deployment team within the Planetary Health Biosolutions (PHB) business division. Working at the intersection of applied AI, commercial problem-solving, and business transformation, you will turn high-value opportunities into practical AI solutions that transform how commercial teams operate.
  
  
This is a senior, forward-deployed engineering role for someone who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to navigate complexity and ambiguity. You will take ownership of strategic AI initiatives, shaping their vision, architecture, development, deployment, and adoption while delivering measurable business value.
  
  
**The Role & Your Impact**
In this role, you will design, build, deploy, and continuously improve AI-driven solutions that enhance commercial effectiveness across PHB. You will work directly with business stakeholders, technical teams, and enterprise partners to solve meaningful problems and accelerate the adoption of AI across commercial functions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI Solution Development & Commercial Transformation**

* Partner with PHB commercial teams to understand complex workflows, business challenges, and user needs.
* Translate opportunities into practical AI solutions that create measurable business value.
* Design and build AI agents, applications, and workflows leveraging prompting, grounding, retrieval, tool use, actions, and orchestration.
* Develop and validate thin-slice solutions to assess user value and technical feasibility.
* Iterate rapidly based on user feedback and business outcomes.
* Lead multiple AI initiatives simultaneously, owning technical direction and delivery outcomes.
* You will work alongside other Applied AI engineers who also run projects independently. Your distinction will be the ability to take on the assignments with the greatest ambiguity, integration complexity, enterprise risk or cross-functional scope, while helping establish reusable technical patterns and a consistently high engineering and evaluation bar across the team.

**Integration & Engineering**

* Define solution architectures for complex enterprise use cases and evaluate trade-offs across custom applications, Microsoft platforms, Salesforce capabilities, enterprise services, and third-party providers.
* Integrate AI solutions securely with enterprise platforms including Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and approved AI services.
* Build integrations using APIs, connectors, and workflow technologies while implementing appropriate identity, authorization, and approval controls.
* Develop solutions utilizing both structured and unstructured data, enterprise knowledge repositories, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns.
* Ensure solutions are secure, scalable, maintainable, reusable, and aligned with responsible AI principles.

**Evaluation, Deployment & Scaling**

* Establish evaluation methodologies, quality standards, and release criteria for AI solutions.
* Design and execute functional, integration, regression, and AI-specific evaluations covering reliability, groundedness, retrieval quality, agent behavior, and user experience.
* Validate solutions with users and determine whether to scale, iterate, or discontinue initiatives based on evidence.
* Deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve production solutions.
* Document architectures, patterns, and learnings to support future reuse and scale across the organization.

**Required Qualifications**
**What You'll Need to Be Successful**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4–8 years of relevant professional experience building and deploying AI, GenAI, or agent-based solutions in real-world environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, prompting, grounding, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool use, and orchestration techniques.
* Strong programming skills in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Experience with APIs, data integration, version control (Git), testing, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience building enterprise workflows and integrations using technologies such as Microsoft Power Platform, Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, Salesforce Flow, REST APIs, or comparable solutions.
* Experience taking AI solutions from prototype to production, including testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Understanding of cloud platforms, identity and access management, secure data handling, responsible AI, and operational reliability.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Salesforce Agentforce, UiPath, or similar enterprise AI platforms.
* Experience working with commercial, sales, marketing, or customer-facing business functions.
* Demonstrated ability to select appropriate technologies based on business outcomes rather than platform preference.
* Experience operating effectively in highly ambiguous and fast-changing environments.

What We Offer
  
  
At Novonesis, you will help shape how AI transforms commercial operations across a global, purpose-driven organization. You will work alongside experienced colleagues, gain exposure to cutting-edge AI technologies, and contribute to solutions that create tangible value for customers and the business.
  
  
We offer an environment that encourages innovation, learning, ownership, and professional growth while supporting our purpose of unlocking the power of biology to address global challenges.
  
  
**Application Deadline:**
November 23rd November 2026 We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible."

In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. title: Senior Principal Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
Do you bring the engineering judgement to turn complex Medical Affairs opportunities into working digital, data, analytics, and AI solutions? Can you embed directly with business teams, move rapidly from problem framing to proof of concept, and then engineer successful solutions for secure, compliant production use at scale?
  
  
As Senior Principal Engineer for Global Medical Affairs Digital & Tech, you will work side by side with Medical Affairs leaders, product teams, data scientists, engineers, and end users to build solutions that improve Measurement, Analytics and Insights. Unlike a role focused only on PoCs and MVPs, this position owns the path from discovery and rapid validation through production deployment, adoption, scaling, and continuous improvement.
  
  
You will focus on high-value opportunities across Data Generation, Scientific Communications, Medical Information, and MSL Engagement. The outcome is not slideware or isolated pilots. It is working, trusted software and analytics that are used in real workflows and deliver measurable Medical Affairs value.
  
  
**Why This Role Exists**

* Global Medical Affairs needs engineers who can close the gap between business questions, scientific workflows, fragmented data, and scalable technology. This role combines deep customer embedding, rapid engineering, production accountability, and reusable platform thinking so that promising ideas become durable capabilities.
* Proves value quickly — frames priority problems and delivers PoCs, PoVs, and MVPs at pace using real data and workflows.
* Takes solutions to production — engineers validated concepts for secure, reliable, compliant, and supportable use.
* Scales what works — expands successful products across therapy areas, regions, teams, and use cases while creating reusable patterns.
* Improves decisions and impact — builds Measurement, Analytics and Insights solutions that help Medical Affairs understand performance, identify opportunities, and act.
* Oversee Strategic partners – work directly with GSK Tech strategic partners and their engineering teams to ensure solutions are designed, engineering and can be supported in production
* environments.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Embedded Discovery, Prototyping and Value Validation**

* Embed with Medical Affairs teams to understand scientific and operational workflows, decision points, user needs, data constraints, and measures of value.
* Own high-priority use cases from problem framing through PoC, PoV, and MVP, using short delivery cycles and direct user feedback.
* Prototype against representative data and real workflows, testing desirability, feasibility, usability, data quality, and business value before material investment.
* Form and defend evidence-based continue, pivot, or stop recommendations with clear implications for investment and scale.

**Production Engineering and Scale**

* Own the transition from validated MVP to production, including architecture, engineering, integration, testing, security, controls, deployment, observability, documentation, and support readiness.
* Build reliable, maintainable solutions that meet GSK Digital and Tech requirements for privacy, quality, compliance, performance, resilience, and user experience.
* Scale successful solutions across therapy areas, regions, and Medical Affairs functions by designing configurable components, reusable services, data products, and reference architectures.
* Establish product measures and production telemetry to track adoption, service performance, decision impact, realised value, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Address technical debt and production issues pragmatically, balancing speed with long-term sustainability and total cost of ownership.

**Measurement, Analytics and Insights Solutions**

* Data Generation: build data and analytics products that improve visibility across evidence planning, study execution, evidence generation, data quality, analysis, and reporting.
* Scientific Communications: develop measurement and insight capabilities across medical writing, publications, congress activity, content development, scientific dissemination, reach, engagement, and impact.
* Medical Information: create analytics and AI-enabled solutions that identify inquiry trends, knowledge gaps, response performance, content needs, and emerging scientific questions while supporting accurate and compliant operations.
* MSL Engagement: build solutions that strengthen planning and measurement of scientific exchange, stakeholder engagement, field insights, content use, follow-up, and the translation of field observations into actionable Medical Affairs insights.
* Cross-functional impact measurement: connect data across these domains to create trusted metrics, dashboards, analytical products, and decision-support experiences that demonstrate Medical Affairs value and identify where action is needed.

**AI-Native Engineering**

* Use AI coding assistants and agent-based workflows for planning, coding, testing, review, documentation, and operational support, applying human judgement and validation throughout.
* Apply GenAI, machine learning, natural language processing, knowledge retrieval, and advanced analytics where they are appropriate to the problem and evidence supports their use.
* Design human-in-the-loop controls, evaluation approaches, and monitoring so AI-enabled capabilities remain accurate, explainable, responsible, and fit for Medical Affairs use.

**Partnership, Governance and Reuse**

* Partner with Medical Affairs Digital & Tech Product Directors, Enterprise Data and AI, architecture, Cyber Security, Quality, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, and shared engineering services.
* Embed security, privacy, quality, records, Responsible AI, and regulatory requirements from discovery through production rather than treating governance as a late-stage gate.
* Distil each engagement into reusable code, data models, agents, prompts, evaluation assets, APIs, patterns, and reference architectures.
* Coach product teams and Medical Affairs Digital and Tech colleagues in AI-augmented delivery, analytical thinking, experimentation, and product adoption.

**What You Bring**
**Required Experience:**

* At least 10 years of full-stack, data, analytics, or software engineering experience, including ownership of production deployments and scaled enterprise solutions.
* Strong proficiency in modern software languages, plus experience with at least one modern application development language or framework such as TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Phyton, or similar.
* Experience with data engineering, analytics products, APIs, cloud platforms, modern software engineering, testing, DevSecOps, observability, and production support.
* Experience applying GenAI patterns such as agents, multi-agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, evaluation, and responsible human oversight.
* Experience in working with senior business stakeholders and end users, translate needs into technical choices, and communicate trade-offs clearly.
* Experience delivering technology in a regulated or high-control environment with strong expectations for security, privacy, quality, and compliance.

**Preferred Experience.**

* A master's degree in a related field is advantageous.
* Experience building measurement frameworks, data products, dashboards, analytical applications, decision-support tools, or insight-generation capabilities.
* Familiarity with Medical Affairs processes across data generation, scientific communications and publications, medical information, field medical or MSL engagement, and impact measurement.
* Prior experience in a senior principal engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, product engineering, or startup environment.
* Track record of scaling a successful solution across multiple markets, business units, or user groups while improving reuse and reducing delivery time.

**Education**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
**Skills Profile**
**Capability**
**G6 expectation**
**Delivery**
Embeds with users, frames ambiguous problems, prototypes quickly, and iterates using evidence and direct feedback.
  
  
**Technical Ownership**
Engineers validated concepts into secure, compliant, observable, supportable products and remains accountable through adoption and stabilisation.
  
  
**Scale and Reuse**
Designs configurable, reusable components and patterns that allow successful solutions to expand across functions, therapy areas, and regions.
  
  
**Measurement and Analytics**
Translates Medical Affairs objectives into trusted measures, analytical products, insights, and decision-support experiences.
  
  
**Technical Judgement**
Makes sound architecture, data, AI, and engineering decisions with incomplete information while balancing value, risk, speed, and sustainability.
  
  
**Customer Partnership**
Builds trusted relationships with Medical Affairs leaders, product owners, scientists, analysts, engineers, and operational teams.
  
  
**Responsible Innovation**
Integrates security, privacy, quality, compliance, and Responsible AI into delivery from the start.
  
  
**Capability Building**
Leaves teams stronger by coaching colleagues and contributing reusable assets, standards, and ways of working.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
In the first 12 months, the person in this role will have:
  
  

* Owned multiple high-priority Medical Affairs engagements from problem framing through prototype, production deployment, adoption, and measurable value realisation.
* Put at least one new Measurement, Analytics and Insights solution into production and established a credible path to scale across additional teams, therapy areas, or regions.
* Improved decision-making or operational performance in one or more priority domains: Data Generation, Scientific Communications, Medical Information, or MSL Engagement.
* Established clear product metrics and production monitoring covering adoption, data quality, service performance, user experience, and realised business value.
* Contributed reusable engineering, data, analytics, or AI assets that materially accelerate subsequent Medical Affairs solutions.
* Built strong trust with Medical Affairs and Tech stakeholders as an embedded technical partner who delivers working outcomes, not only recommendations.

**About Global Medical Affairs And Medical Digital & Tech**
Global Medical Affairs generates and communicates scientific evidence to support informed decision-making, demonstrate product value, and enable high-quality scientific exchange with healthcare professionals. Its work spans evidence and data generation, scientific communications and publications, medical information, field medical and MSL engagement, and the measurement of Medical Affairs impact.
  
  
Global Medical Affairs Digital & Tech enables this mission through secure, compliant, user-centred digital, data, analytics, and AI capabilities across therapy areas, regions, and central functions. The team partners with Medical Affairs to modernise workflows, connect data, generate actionable insights, improve stakeholder experiences, and scale solutions that deliver measurable scientific and business value.
